summary: Frontend-only E2E of new Media tab (Emergent Object Storage) in Squawk King IA. All 10 UI steps passed: login as <demo-admin-email-redacted>, Media tab renders between Manuals and History (order verified: aircraft, manuals, media, history, logbook), empty-state message + hidden upload panel when no aircraft selected, aircraft-selector -> N172SK, upload panel (media-caption + media-file inputs) present, PNG upload with caption succeeds (POST /api/media returns and appears in media-grid), image thumbnail renders via authenticated blob URL (blob:https://...) from GET /api/media/{id}/download, caption + KB size shown, delete via media-delete-<id> removes item from grid, regression on Manuals and Logbook tabs still renders. Skills loaded: none new (frontend-only test; ai-testing-core skill relevant AI features already verified in iteration_1). No blocking issues.
ai_feature_verdicts: Emergent Object Storage upload+download (used by /api/media) - pass - evidence: uploaded 89-byte PNG via file input, item appeared in media-grid, GET /api/media/{id}/download returned bytes that produced a blob: URL rendered as thumbnail; DELETE removed item from grid. Provider/key: EMERGENT_LLM_KEY (universal). Skill: not applicable (deterministic object storage, not generative).

issues: Sonner toasts (top-right) briefly overlap the Workbench tab header and the Media upload panel/caption field — same known non-blocking overlap flagged in iteration_1. Consider shorter toast duration or offset.

critical_code_review_comments: Workbench.jsx MediaThumb (line 279): fetch for blob thumbnail does not check res.ok — if the download endpoint 401s or 500s the thumbnail will silently stay in skeleton state without a user-facing error. Add res.ok guard + toast/fallback icon.

Workbench.jsx MediaTab open() (line 335): opens the download URL with ?auth=<jwt> as a query param — same auth-in-URL concern already noted for manuals download in iteration_1 (token in browser history / server access logs). Consider a short-lived signed download URL.

Workbench.jsx MediaTab upload() (line 322): api.post with 'Content-Type': 'multipart/form-data' explicitly set — this can break the browser's automatic multipart boundary generation with some axios versions. Best practice is to omit Content-Type and let the browser/axios set it. Upload worked in this run, so not blocking, but fragile.
server.py delete_media (line 366) always returns success even if no matching document was updated — should return 404 if media_id not found or not owned by user.

server.py download_media (line 371) correctly scopes by user_id (payload['sub']) — addresses the authz gap flagged for /api/manuals download in iteration_1. Recommend applying the same ownership check to the manuals download endpoint.

success_rate.backend: not tested this iteration (frontend-only per review_request; backend already verified via curl per agent-to-agent note)
